content_sections.heading: CSIR AMPRI Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the CSIR AMPRI Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download CSIR AMPRI Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: B.E/B.Tech (Civil / Mechanical Engineering) from a recognized University or equivalent. Experience in Operation & Maintenance of RMC Plant, Development of Geopolymeric Concrete & cement concrete, Testing of Engineering properties for Concrete specimen. B.E/B.Tech (Civil / Mechanical Engineering) from a recognized University or equivalent. M.Tech (Structural Engineering/ Construction Technology). Experience in Mixed Design of Geopolymeric Concrete, filed work, Engineering Properties Testing and Development of Precast Geopolymeric Components. BE/B.Tech in Mechanical / Materials / Metallurgical / Production / Chemical Engineering from a recognized University. Proficiency in CAD modelling and component design using software such as SolidWorks, AutoCAD, CATIA, Fusion 360, or similar design Packages. M.Sc. Chemistry / Physics from recognized University. OR BTech in Chemical Engineering or Polymer Engineering or Polymer Technology or Rubber Technology or Polymer Science and Rubber Technology from a recognized University. Preference will be given to the Candidates who are having experience in synthetic Chemistry and high energy ionizing radiations. M.Sc. in Chemistry/ Physics along with NET/GATE qualification in Physical/ Chemical Sciences from recognized University. M.Sc. Project on Computational Chemistry/ Physics knowledge on programming language. Post Graduate Degree Chemistry/ Nanotechnology/ Biotechnology/ Material Sciences, OR Engineering four years graduate degree specialized in Nanotechnology/ Biotechnology/ Material Sciences. Candidate with experiences in synthesis of nanoparticles and characterization using analytical techniques, knowledge of electrochemistry, Biomaterials, 3D Bioprinter, fabrication of aptasensor based diagnostics, and scientific writing as evidenced by peer-reviewed publications will be preferred.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for CSIR AMPRI Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the total number of vacancies in CSIR AMPRI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 7 vacancies announced for various posts including Project Associate-I, JRF, and Project Research Scientist-I in the CSIR AMPRI Recruitment 2026. These positions are project-based and offer opportunities in research.

faq.question: Q2. What are the key dates for CSIR AMPRI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The online application started on 29 August 2026, with the last date to apply online being 15 September 2026. Walk-in interviews are scheduled from 16 September 2026 to 18 September 2026, depending on the post code.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the CSIR AMPRI Project Associate-I posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all posts in the CSIR AMPRI recruitment is 35 years. Age relaxation is applicable for reserved categories, with 5 years for SC/ST/PwBD/Women and 3 years for OBC candidates.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary range for Project Associate-I positions at CSIR AMPRI?
faq.answer: The salary for Project Associate-I (PAT-I) ranges from Rs. 25,000 + HRA for non-NET/GATE qualified candidates to Rs. 31,000 + HRA for NET/GATE qualified candidates per month, based on the specific post code.

faq.question: Q5. What qualifications are required for Project Associate-I positions?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for Project Associate-I positions should possess a B.E/B.Tech in relevant engineering fields like Civil, Mechanical, Materials, Metallurgical, Production, Chemical, or M.Sc. in Chemistry/Physics from a recognized university.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for the CSIR AMPRI recruitment?
faq.answer: Interested candidates must first apply through the online portal available on the official AMPRI website (www.ampri.res.in) between 29 August 2026 and 15 September 2026. Subsequently, eligible candidates are required to appear for a walk-in interview as per the schedule.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for CSIR AMPRI recruitment involves an initial online application, followed by document verification, and finally a walk-in interview. Candidates must ensure they meet all eligibility criteria before proceeding.

faq.question: Q8. Where will the walk-in interviews be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interviews for the CSIR AMPRI recruitment will be conducted at CSIR-AMPRI, Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh. Candidates are advised to check the official notification for the exact venue address and reporting times.

faq.question: Q9. Are there any application fees for CSIR AMPRI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for the CSIR AMPRI Recruitment 2026. Candidates can apply online and attend the walk-in interview without paying any fee.

faq.question: Q10. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates attending the walk-in interview must carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies (ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates, category certificate), a duly filled application form (if required), and extra passport-size photographs.
